accent.usage: Primary brand accent — CTAs, active states, key node borders

accent_light.usage: Secondary accent — links, connector lines, chip text on dark

accent_glow.usage: Existing decorative glow (CTA button pulse) — do not add new instances

surface.usage: Card / node background fill on the dark page

border.usage: Default hairline borders on cards, nodes, chips

page_bg.usage: Body background (set directly on <body> in Layout.astro, not a CSS var)

body.usage: Set on <body> in Layout.astro; all page and component text inherits this stack

typography.scale_note: Tailwind v4 utility scale (text-xs through text-[3.25rem]) — no separate custom type scale file. New components should reuse existing utility classes or match their computed sizes.

prohibited_treatments: regenerate or reproduce the logo via an AI image generator
add a drop shadow or outline not already produced by BrandLogo.astro
logo_rules.notes: BrandLogo.astro uses Astro's build-time image pipeline against public/logo.png to emit WebP at 32/64/96px widths. No third-party tracker/vendor logos are used anywhere on the site (design.md, TrackerFlow.astro) — sources are rendered as plain text chips.

motion_rules.pattern: stroke-dasharray/stroke-dashoffset 'draw-on' animation (see .ecg-main/.ecg-glow in index.astro, .tf-flow-line in TrackerFlow.astro), plus gentle opacity/translate loops (ring-breathe, peak-pulse, float-up, glow-pulse).
motion_rules.reduced_motion: Every decorative animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, and every dash-offset animation resolves to stroke-dashoffset: 0 so the line stays visible rather than disappearing.
motion_rules.prohibited: No staggered entrance/fade-in animation on critical above-the-fold content (design.md). No new decorative gradient glows or blurred-blob shapes (ai-tells-rubric.md T1) beyond what already exists in index.astro's hero.

canonical_assets.description: Source app icon / mark, square PNG
canonical_assets.usage: Source for BrandLogo.astro's build-time WebP pipeline (32/64/96px). Never referenced directly at full size.

canonical_assets.description: App Store 6.9" screenshot, slot 2 — 'Every tracker that shares with Apple Health' marketing poster (full tracker-flow diagram, proof line, footnote)
canonical_assets.generated_by: Headless Chrome (Playwright, channel: chrome) render of a standalone HTML export of the TrackerFlow composition
canonical_assets.usage: App Store Connect screenshot upload, slot 2 (6.9" display class). Not referenced by any website page.

canonical_assets.description: Social share image — 'Every tracker that shares with Apple Health' condensed flow + proof line
canonical_assets.generated_by: Headless Chrome (Playwright, channel: chrome) render of a standalone HTML export
canonical_assets.usage: Available for future og:image / social-card use. Not wired into any page's <meta property="og:image"> yet — the sitewide default remains https://health4.ai/logo.png (Layout.astro).

TrackerFlow.astro.description: Animated inline-SVG/HTML flow diagram: many tracker brands (grouped by category) -> Apple Health -> health4ai -> your own database -> AI clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Ollama). Text chips only, no third-party logos.
TrackerFlow.astro.accessibility: Visual diagram is aria-hidden; a sr-only <ul> describes the same flow for assistive tech. Animation (SVG stroke-dashoffset flow) is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion, with the diagram left fully visible.
